name: Mui Ne food
summary: Mui Ne eats from the sea: a hotpot, sun-dried squid, a fish salad wrapped in rice paper, and grilled seafood picked from the tanks on the sea wall. Phan Thiet, the neighboring city on the same coast, adds its own fish spring roll and fish salad.
body: Start with lẩu thả, mực một nắng, and gỏi cá mai, then walk the sea wall by the fishing village for dinner. Most restaurants line Nguyễn Đình Chiểu and Tuyên Quang.

The wider Binh Thuan coast menu brings crab, snail and fish salads, sour soups, curries, and folk cakes such as bánh căn and bánh rế. Garlic scallops are the sea-wall plate. Sò điệp is the coast-menu name for scallops.
specialtiesLead: Lẩu thả, mực một nắng, cá mai, ốc hương, dông, bánh canh, bánh xèo, bánh quai vạc, răng mực, and the fish spring roll, then the sea-wall grill and the Binh Thuan coast menu.

sections.heading: Mui Ne specialties
paragraphs: The first ten are Mui Ne's own plates. The sea-wall grill comes next, then dishes from the wider Binh Thuan coast menu.

spots.name: Lau tha
spots.note: A hotpot of fish, shrimp, pork, vegetables, green mango, banana flower, rice noodles, and fried egg in a broth flavored with peanuts, chili, and lime. It is a mainstay of a Mui Ne table.

spots.name: Muc mot nang
spots.address: Mui Ne and the Binh Thuan coast
spots.note: Squid dried in the sun, then grilled over coals with a chili and lime baste. Dip it in fish sauce.

spots.name: Ca mai
spots.note: A salad of mai fish with basil, onion, green banana, star fruit, chili, garlic, and roasted peanuts. Wrap it in rice paper and dip it in fish sauce.

spots.name: Oc huong
spots.note: Sweet sea snails in speckled shells, steamed with onion and ginger, baked, grilled, or roasted with garlic. Pull the meat from the shell, add lime, and dip it in crushed peanuts.

spots.name: Dong
spots.note: Lizard, most often grilled and served as chewy seasoned strips with chili. It also turns up stir-fried, in soup, in salads, in rolls, in porridge, and in pastries. Another list is seven plates: grilled, steamed, fried, roasted, raw, porridge, and pie.

spots.name: Banh canh
spots.note: Thick tapioca or rice-flour noodles in fish stock with fried and steamed fish cakes, scallions, cilantro, dried onion, peppers, and lime. A bowl of local comfort food.

spots.name: Banh xeo
spots.note: A fried folded pancake filled with shrimp, fatty pork, and bean sprouts, dipped in chili, garlic, lemon, and fish sauce. Mui Ne's signature street food.

spots.name: Banh quai vac
spots.note: Translucent bite-size wheat-flour cakes with prawn, fatty pork, scallions, and chili, boiled. Sold as quai vạc trần on street corners.

spots.name: Rang muc
spots.note: Marble-sized squid beaks, marinated, skewered, and grilled. Elsewhere in Binh Thuan they come stir-fried with onions.

spots.name: Fish spring roll
spots.note: Fish and cassava rolled in rice paper, fried, and dipped in a spicy sauce. The roll belongs to Phan Thiet, and Mui Ne is where to eat it.

spots.name: Fresh oysters
spots.address: Sea wall by the fishing village
spots.note: Oysters picked from the tanks along the sea wall and cooked to order on the grill. A dinner plate with a beer and the sea beside you.

spots.name: Lemongrass clams
spots.address: Sea wall by the fishing village
spots.note: Clams cooked with lemongrass, one of the sea-wall grill plates. Order them at dinner with the rest of the catch.

spots.name: So diep
spots.address: Sea wall by the fishing village and the Binh Thuan coast
spots.note: Scallops, cooked with garlic on the sea-wall grill and listed as sò điệp on the Binh Thuan coast menu. A dinner plate on the wall.

spots.name: Grilled prawns
spots.address: Sea wall by the fishing village
spots.note: Prawns picked from the tanks and grilled on the sea wall. Order them at dinner with the rest of the catch.

spots.name: Crispy fish
spots.address: Sea wall by the fishing village
spots.note: A crispy fried fish from the sea-wall grill. Order it at dinner with the rest of the catch.

spots.name: Chili stuffed squid
spots.address: Sea wall by the fishing village
spots.note: Squid stuffed with chili, from the sea-wall menu. A dinner plate, separate from the dried squid and the grilled beaks.

spots.name: Cua huynh de
spots.note: Cua huỳnh đế, a crab from the Binh Thuan coastal menu. One of the province's seafood plates.

spots.name: Goi oc giac
spots.note: A salad of ốc giác snail. One of the coastal plates on Binh Thuan menus.

spots.name: Goi ca duc
spots.note: A salad of cá đục fish. It is a different plate from the cá mai salad.

spots.name: Cha ca
spots.note: Fish cake from the Binh Thuan coast menu. It is a separate plate from the fish cakes in bánh canh.

spots.name: Canh chua ca bop
spots.note: A sour soup made with cá bóp. One of the coastal plates on Binh Thuan menus.

spots.name: Ca bung binh nau ca ri
spots.nameVi: Cá bùng binh nấu cà ri
spots.note: Cá bùng binh fish cooked as a curry. One of the coastal plates on Binh Thuan menus.

spots.name: Ca bo hom hap
spots.note: Steamed cá bò hòm. One of the coastal plates on Binh Thuan menus.

spots.name: Ca loi xoi mo
spots.note: Cá lồi with hot fat poured over it, as the name xối mỡ says. One of the coastal plates on Binh Thuan menus.

spots.name: Banh re
spots.note: A rice pancake and a local favorite across Binh Thuan. One of the province's folk dishes.

spots.name: Com
spots.note: Cốm, a Binh Thuan folk sweet. It is served alongside bánh rế and bánh căn.

spots.name: Banh can
spots.note: Bánh căn, one of Binh Thuan's folk dishes. A breakfast plate.

spots.name: Phan Thiet fish salad
spots.note: The fish salad of Phan Thiet, the neighboring city. It is a separate plate from the cá mai and cá đục salads.

sections.heading: International dining
paragraphs: The food court on Nguyễn Đình Chiểu gathers foreign kitchens under one roof: Mexican, Italian, American barbecue, Hungarian, and vegan, plus a smokehouse, a wine shop, a handmade chocolate shop, a cafe, a bar, and a nightclub.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: Eat at the dawn market, on the sea wall, or along Nguyễn Đình Chiểu and Tuyên Quang.

spots.name: Fishing-village market
spots.note: Come just after dawn to watch the catch come off the boats and the bargaining on the sand, then join the cards and coffee. By noon the market is over.

spots.name: Sea wall
spots.address: Along the beach near the fishing village.
spots.note: Grill stalls along the wall cook seafood picked from the tanks: oysters, clams, scallops, prawns, crispy fish, and chili stuffed squid. Come for dinner.

spots.name: Nguyen Dinh Chieu
spots.address: The road from the center of Mui Ne toward the fishing village, provincial road 706.
spots.note: The main restaurant road, with rooms from cozy to cosmopolitan. It runs from the center of Mui Ne toward the fishing village.

spots.name: Tuyen Quang
spots.note: The second restaurant street, paired with Nguyễn Đình Chiểu.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: Mornings start at the fishing village with coffee and cards after the dawn catch, and bánh căn is the folk breakfast plate. A coconut at a Fairy Stream rest stop and a beer with the sea-wall dinner round out the day.

spots.name: Dawn coffee
spots.note: Coffee and a game of cards once the catch is on the sand. Come just after dawn.

seoTitle: Mui Ne food — lẩu thả, dried squid, and the sea wall
seoDescription: Lẩu thả, mực một nắng, cá mai, and the sea-wall grill in Mui Ne, plus the Binh Thuan coast menu and the restaurant road on Nguyễn Đình Chiểu.
